gamePoints.formula: FBL (Yahoo): PTS+REB+AST+STL+BLK-(FGA-FGM)-(FTA-FTM)-2*TOV-PF+1 per game played, on ESPN's box score of the game (pointsSource ESPN), the only source of FBL points (league owner, 22.10.2026). A played Sports.ru row ESPN has no line for yet has no points (AWAITING_ESPN); the Sports.ru game table's own box score (2О+3О of В20+В3О, Ш of ВШ, О, ПБ, ПР, ПХ, БШ, П, Ф) is kept as sportsBoxPoints for the reconciliation only
gamePoints.check: sportsPoints = box score + Sports.ru's result bonus (+2/+3 home/away win, -3/-2 home/away loss) + 1 for 10+ minutes once Sports.ru counts the game: MISMATCH when not, UNCOUNTED while ФО is 0
